title: The Vampire Slayer’s Offer
description:
How many times do we need to do this dance? You're an immortal vampire. You lot are immortal, right? Yet you decide of all things to chase a vampire slayer? Pretty stupid if you ask me. But hey, all those years alive probably aren't good for the brain. Maybe you just need a thrill.

Thing is, there are better thrills for a vampire. Hypnosis, a little cunnilingus, and a taste of the slayer. You thought our blood had extra power? Well, yes it does, but other things do too. Why don't you just listen to me explain how we can end this vampire and slayer dance, and if I hypnotize you to end up on your knees in the graveyard worshipping my pussy, well, that's just you tasting a little of that extra slayer power, isn't it?

A Buffy-inspired vampire and slayer hypnosis file focusing on servitude, body worship and witty banter.

Art by Tanoshoku
author: Mistress Calia
